title: The linear 4-uniform hypergraph transversal conjecture
statement:
Let $H$ be a $4$-uniform hypergraph on $n$ vertices with $m$ edges. Recall that $H$ is **linear** if every two edges intersect in at most one vertex, and let $\tau(H)$ denote its transversal number. **The linear transversal conjecture.** If $H$ is linear, then

$$
\tau(H)\le \frac{n}{4}+\frac{m}{6}.
$$

The paper presents this as a proposed extension of its bounded-degree result. It is motivated by the failure of the same bound for some hypergraphs of maximum degree at least $4$, while linearity rules out repeated intersections between pairs of edges.
source_name: Michael A. Henning and Anders Yeo, “Transversals in 4-Uniform Hypergraphs”, arXiv:1504.02650 (2015).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1504.02650

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2015).
